name: core--imot2026-media-cache-big-disk
description: Backport imot2026 media-cache directory placement to the big data disk (/var/lib/docker-data/imot2026-media-cache on /dev/sdb) instead of root disk (/dev/sda2) to prevent root disk exhaustion on vm700.

changes: Added imot2026_media_cache_host_path default in defaults/main.yaml pointing to /var/lib/docker-data/imot2026-media-cache.
Added task in roles/ops-settings/tasks/imot2026.yaml ensuring directory exists with owner 10001:10001 mode 0750.

checks.check: host directory /var/lib/docker-data/imot2026-media-cache exists with owner 10001:10001 mode 0750 on /dev/sdb
